newsitem.title: USA: Ciatti's files for rights offering.
newsitem.headline: Ciatti's files for rights offering.

text.p: Ciatti's Inc said Tuesday it filed for a rights offering of its common stock.

The offering will be made to all shareholders of the company with each holder receiving the right to purchase, at a yet to be determined price, two shares of common stock for every one share owned by the shareholder.
Ciatti's intends to use proceeds of the offering to expand the number of its Bruegger's Bagel Bakery restaurants in the Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas, area.
The company expects the offering to start in early October and be open for about 30 days. The record date is yet to be determined.
Ciatti's owns and operates 10 full-service Italian and Steakhouse restaurants in Minnesota and Wisconsin and is exclusive franchisee for Bruegger's Bagel Bakery restaurants in Dallas-Fort Worth.
